tables.name: control_db.platform.businesses
tables.purpose: Trusted business boundary; not selected by user/LLM text.
checks: domain in sales,bise,hospital; status in active,disabled; config_version > 0
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: control_db.platform.instances
tables.purpose: Trusted Evolution instance-to-business mapping; references credentials, never stores tokens.
checks: Unique trusted routing mapping across businesses; status active/disabled
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: control_db.platform.audit_events
tables.purpose: Append-only security/business metadata; no raw messages or credentials.
checks: Details key/size allowlist; runtime cannot UPDATE/DELETE audit rows
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: control_db.platform.configuration_outbox
tables.purpose: Configuration publication intent committed with authoritative configuration and audit.
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: control_db.platform.reporting_events
tables.purpose: Immutable minimized reporting inbox; same-key different hash quarantined.
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

externalReferences.contract: Authenticated producer fixes origin_database; immutable event hash, deduplication and source reconciliation; no cross-database FK.

tables.name: control_db.platform.session_directory
tables.purpose: Routing/status projection only; domain session remains authoritative.
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

externalReferences.contract: Versioned projection, never an authorization grant; dangling references marked unavailable after recovery.

tables.name: pos_db.platform.businesses
tables.purpose: Read-only domain projection of central routing/configuration; only scoped configuration consumer may update.
checks: domain in sales,bise,hospital; status in active,disabled; config_version > 0
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

externalReferences.contract: Versioned authenticated configuration events; never a cross-database FK; expired configuration denies dispatch.

tables.name: pos_db.platform.instances
tables.purpose: Read-only domain projection of central routing/configuration; only scoped configuration consumer may update.
checks: Unique trusted routing mapping across businesses; status active/disabled
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

externalReferences.contract: Versioned authenticated configuration events; never a cross-database FK; expired configuration denies dispatch.

tables.name: pos_db.platform.contacts
tables.purpose: Tenant-local person/customer reference; does not imply verified identity.
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.platform.channel_identities
tables.purpose: Channel participant linked to contact within an instance; shared numbers require separate subject grants.
checks: JID retained as identifier; LID is not assumed to be a phone number
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.platform.conversations
tables.purpose: Conversation identity, scope and operator handoff state.
checks: Initial pilot direct chats only; version > 0
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.platform.sessions
tables.purpose: Bounded context and pending-intent state; never authoritative authorization from LLM memory.
checks: created_at <= last_seen_at < expires_at <= absolute_expires_at; absolute expiry immutable; version > 0; state schema/size allowlist enforced by service
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.platform.verification_grants
tables.purpose: Server-created actor-to-subject authorization, including explicit guardian/delegate permission.
checks: expires_at > created_at; no raw CNIC, OTP, or evidence documents stored; scope is registered
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.platform.requests
tables.purpose: Durable normalized ingress and duplicate-event boundary.
checks: attempts >= 0; identifier nonempty; no raw event payload
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.platform.messages
tables.purpose: Redacted persistent conversational history; provider IDs and request link support deduplication.
checks: direction inbound/outbound; role user/assistant/operator/system; initial one response per request; null request allowed for separately keyed proactive actions
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.platform.actions
tables.purpose: Confirmed immutable business intent and execution/idempotency state.
checks: Same key/different payload rejects; expires_at > created_at; minimized typed payload; version > 0
Grant, if required, must belong to this session and match action subject/scope; validate on execution, not only action creation
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.platform.approvals
tables.purpose: Expiring approval bound to action hash/version; operator identity is an external trusted principal.
checks: decision approve/reject; authenticated approver has permission; one-time use checked transactionally
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.platform.outbox
tables.purpose: Durable response dispatch; records accepted/unknown separately from delivered.
checks: attempts >= 0; ambiguous send enters unknown, not blindly pending
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.platform.audit_events
tables.purpose: Append-only security/business metadata; no raw messages or credentials.
checks: Details key/size allowlist; runtime cannot UPDATE/DELETE audit rows
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.platform.tool_runs
tables.purpose: Trace tool outcome/evidence, latency and versions without duplicating sensitive result bodies.
checks: duration_ms >= 0; redact source references as required
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.platform.handoffs
tables.purpose: Operator ownership and bot pause/resume record.
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.crm.leads
tables.purpose: Lead state separate from appointments/orders; initial single active lead per contact.
checks: Stage allowlist per business; version > 0; general inquiry cannot silently reset progressed lead
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.crm.lead_events
tables.purpose: Append-only lead transition history with event deduplication and stable replay outcome.
checks: expected_version >= 0; result_version = expected_version + 1; payload_hash is canonical SHA-256; repeated key with changed command rejects
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.sales.products
tables.purpose: Public catalog identity and active status.
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.sales.skus
tables.purpose: Sellable variant and current authoritative price; immutable order snapshots preserve past prices.
checks: price >= 0; currency uppercase ISO code; price_version > 0; numeric money, not float
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.sales.inventory
tables.purpose: One stock pool per SKU for initial dummy pilot; warehouses deferred.
checks: 0 <= reserved <= on_hand; version > 0; available = on_hand - reserved, not independently stored
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.sales.orders
tables.purpose: Confirmed order and explicit reservation expiry; no payment secrets.
checks: total >= 0; version > 0; total equals immutable line totals via controlled transaction
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.sales.order_items
tables.purpose: Immutable SKU, quantity and accepted unit-price snapshot.
checks: quantity > 0; unit_price >= 0; price_version > 0
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.sales.payments
tables.purpose: Provider-authoritative payment status/reference; collection/refunds disabled in initial pilot.
checks: amount >= 0; transition/event authenticity checked; timeout -> unknown; no PAN/CVV/secrets
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.knowledge.documents
tables.purpose: Stable approved-source identity, tenant and permitted audience.
checks: No student/patient/private transaction records admitted to shared knowledge
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.knowledge.versions
tables.purpose: Immutable document version and approval/effectivity; unpublished indexes never exposed.
checks: version > 0; dimension > 0; effective_to null or > effective_from; no conflicting active published windows per document unless explicitly segmented
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.knowledge.chunks
tables.purpose: Shared chunk identity for genuine BM25 and pgvector; dimension finalized before vector DDL.
checks: ordinal >= 0; d must match approved embedding dimension; tenant/audience/version filter on both retrieval paths
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.knowledge.ingestion_jobs
tables.purpose: Idempotent extraction/embedding/indexing work with retries and atomic publish gate.
checks: attempts >= 0; published only when both retrieval paths are ready
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: pos_db.platform.configuration_inbox
tables.purpose: Idempotent config receipt and local projection changes committed together.
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

externalReferences.contract: Authenticated provisioning; local registry upsert and inbox record in same domain transaction; config revision replay protection.

tables.name: pos_db.platform.reporting_outbox
tables.purpose: Immutable reporting event inserted with local mutation/audit; delivery fields separately mutable.
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: hospital_db.hospital.slots
tables.purpose: Materialized exclusive consultation slots in one pilot branch; times stored as instants.
checks: ends_at > starts_at; state open/blocked/retired; version > 0
EXCLUDE overlapping [start,end) ranges per business+doctor for non-retired slots; requires btree_gist at migration stage
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: hospital_db.hospital.appointments
tables.purpose: Patient subject is a tenant contact; protected access requires a matching grant, including delegated access.
checks: Partial UNIQUE(business_id,slot_id) for active reserving statuses held/confirmed; version > 0; reschedule atomically retains same booking id
held requires hold_expires_at > created_at; expiry worker transitions status under lock; no clock-dependent index predicate
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: hospital_db.hospital.appointment_events
tables.purpose: Durable booking transition history, including previous/new slot on reschedule.
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval

tables.name: hospital_db.hospital.calendar_sync_jobs
tables.purpose: Version-aware desired external projection and reconciliation; separate from appointment status.
checks: attempts >= 0; appointment_version > 0; stable external identity and stale-job suppression
tables.retention: classification-specific; production duration requires owner approval
